validation.reason: The exact four-stage spec passed validate-spec, plan-spec --check-render, and focused workflow contract tests with a v2 pull manifest.

task_fidelity.reason: Resolved commands and artifact handoffs match push -> curate -> Collection pull -> curated-subset verify. A local live Encord/S3 run selected and verified one of two uploaded items.

output_storage.reason: The live local run wrote and read final push, curation, pull, and verification artifacts in S3.

worker_input.reason: The live local run ingested a 1x1 PNG and a 32x32 MP4, then selected the MP4 as a strict subset.

credentials.reason: Read-only Encord and S3 probes passed, followed by the completed local live roundtrip.

source_image.reason: The CPU pod render is valid and selects the encord extra, but the changed curation command has not run in the worker image.

target_runtime.reason: The four-stage graph passed locally against real Encord and S3 services; Kubernetes pod execution has not been tested.
